problems.title: Sum from 1 to N
problems.problem_statement: Calculate the sum of all integers from 1 through N.
problems.output_format: Print the sum from 1 through N.

bugs.description: The loop stops at i < n instead of including N.
bugs.why_wrong: The required range is 1 through N, so N must also be added.

problems.title: Find the Largest Mark
problems.problem_statement: Read N marks and print the largest mark.
problems.input_format: N followed by N integer marks.

bugs.description: The program replaces largest when the current mark is smaller.
bugs.why_wrong: To find the largest value, the current mark should replace largest only when it is greater.

problems.title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
problems.problem_statement: Convert a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using F = C * 9 / 5 + 32.
problems.output_format: Print the Fahrenheit temperature as an integer.

bugs.description: The program subtracts 32 instead of adding 32.
bugs.why_wrong: The Celsius-to-Fahrenheit formula ends with +32.

problems.title: Count Even Numbers
problems.problem_statement: Read N integers and count how many of them are even.
problems.output_format: Print the count of even integers.

bugs.description: The condition counts odd numbers instead of even numbers.
bugs.why_wrong: An even number has remainder 0 when divided by 2, so only x % 2 == 0 should increment the counter.

problems.title: Factorial of N

bugs.description: The loop stops before multiplying by N.
bugs.why_wrong: N! includes every factor from 1 through N.

problems.title: First Occurrence Search
problems.problem_statement: Find the first index at which a target value occurs in an array. Print -1 if it is absent.
problems.output_format: Print the zero-based index of the first occurrence, or -1.

bugs.description: The loop excludes the last array element.
bugs.why_wrong: The valid indexes run from 0 through n-1, so the last element must also be searched.

problems.title: Reverse a Number
problems.problem_statement: Reverse the digits of a positive integer and print the reversed number.
problems.output_format: Print N with its digits reversed.

bugs.description: The value added to rev uses n / 10 instead of the extracted digit.
bugs.why_wrong: Each iteration must append the last digit, not the remaining prefix of the number.

problems.title: Row Sums of a Matrix
problems.problem_statement: Read a matrix with R rows and C columns and print the sum of each row.
problems.input_format: R C followed by R*C integers.
problems.output_format: Print one row sum per line.

bugs.description: sum is initialized only once before processing all rows.
bugs.why_wrong: Each row needs its own sum; otherwise later rows include the sums of previous rows.

problems.title: Student Result Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Read a student's marks, calculate the total, average, and grade. Grade A is 75 or above, B is 60 or above, C is 40 or above, otherwise F.
problems.output_format: Print Total, Average, and Grade on separate lines. Average is printed as a whole number using integer division.

bugs.description: total starts at 10 instead of 0.
bugs.why_wrong: The total should contain only the student's marks.

bugs.description: The total is always divided by 3 instead of by the number of subjects n.
bugs.why_wrong: The average is total divided by the number of marks entered.

bugs.description: The A grade condition uses > 75 instead of >= 75.
bugs.why_wrong: A student with an average of exactly 75 should receive A.

bugs.description: The C grade condition uses > 40 instead of >= 40.
bugs.why_wrong: An average of exactly 40 should receive grade C.

problems.title: Shopping Bill
problems.problem_statement: Calculate a shopping bill from item prices and quantities. If the subtotal is at least 1000, give a 10% discount. Then add 5% tax to the discounted subtotal.
problems.input_format: N followed by N pairs of price and quantity.
problems.output_format: Print subtotal, discount, tax, and final total, each on a separate line. Use integer arithmetic for percentage calculations.

bugs.description: Only price is added, so quantity is ignored.
bugs.why_wrong: The cost of an item is price multiplied by quantity.

bugs.description: The discount is applied only when subtotal is greater than 1000.
bugs.why_wrong: The rule says the discount starts at 1000, so 1000 must qualify.

bugs.description: Tax is calculated from subtotal instead of the discounted subtotal.
bugs.why_wrong: The tax must be 5% of the amount remaining after discount.

bugs.description: The final total uses subtotal instead of the discounted amount afterDiscount.
bugs.why_wrong: The final bill should be the discounted subtotal plus tax.

problems.title: Attendance Eligibility
problems.problem_statement: Read attendance for N classes using 1 for present and 0 for absent. Calculate attendance percentage and print the percentage followed by Eligible or Not Eligible. A student is eligible at 75% or higher.
problems.input_format: N followed by N attendance values (0 or 1).
problems.output_format: Print integer attendance percentage on the first line and Eligible/Not Eligible on the second.

bugs.description: present starts at 1 even though no classes have been processed.
bugs.why_wrong: The count of present classes must start at zero.

bugs.description: The program increments present when status is 0, which means absent.
bugs.why_wrong: Only status 1 should increase the present count.

bugs.description: Integer division happens before multiplication by 100.
bugs.why_wrong: For many attendance values, present / n becomes 0 before it is multiplied by 100.

bugs.description: The program requires percentage to be greater than 75.
bugs.why_wrong: The rule says 75% or higher is eligible.

problems.title: Menu-Based Number Calculator
problems.problem_statement: Perform one arithmetic operation on two integers. Menu 1 is addition, 2 subtraction, 3 multiplication, and 4 integer division.
problems.input_format: An option followed by two integers a and b. Division inputs have b != 0.
problems.output_format: Print the result of the selected operation.

bugs.description: Addition is implemented using subtraction.
bugs.why_wrong: Menu option 1 must calculate a + b.

bugs.description: Subtraction is implemented using addition.
bugs.why_wrong: Menu option 2 must calculate a - b.

bugs.description: Multiplication is implemented using addition.
bugs.why_wrong: Menu option 3 must calculate a * b.

bugs.description: Division uses b / a instead of a / b.
bugs.why_wrong: The calculator should divide the first number by the second number.
